attempts.summary: Segmented node2 onto VLAN 10 (10.10.10.0/24) and node3 onto VLAN 20 (10.10.20.0/24) over their shared link (node1 eth1 / node2+node3 enp8s0), with node1 (VyOS) routing between the VLANs via 802.1q sub-interfaces eth1.10/eth1.20 and explicit forward-filter rules. Verified bidirectional cross-VLAN ping and firewall rule hit-counters. Performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes, proving changed boot IDs and confirming config persistence plus restored connectivity/routing after each restart.
